verses.geez: ወይቤለኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ንሣእ፡ ለከ፡ ጦማረ፡ ክርታስ፡ ዓቢየ፡ ወሐዲሰ፡ ወጸሐፍ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ በብረዓ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ዘይብል፤ ፍጡነ፡ ፄውው፡ ወማህርክ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to me, Take to thyself a volume of a great new book, and write in it with a man's pen concerning the making a rapid plunder of spoils; for it is near at hand.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to me, Take to thyself a volume of a great new book, and write in it with a man's pen concerning the making a rapid plunder of spoils; for it is near at hand.
translations.kjv: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul către mine: "Ia o carte mare şi scrie deasupra ei cu slove omeneşti: "Maher-Şalal-Haş-Baz" (grabnic-pradă-apropiat-jaf).
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς μὲ, λάβε σεαυτῷ τόμον καινοῦ μεγαλοῦ, καὶ γράψον εἰς αὐτὸν γραφίδι ἀνθρώπου, τοῦ ὀξέως προνομὴν ποιῆσαι σκύλων·

verses.geez: ወአስምዕ፡ ሊተ፡ ሰብአ፡ ምእመናነ፡ አርያሃ፡ ወዘካርያስሃ፡ ወልደ፡ በራክዩ።
verses.translation: And make me witnesses of faithful men, Urias, and Zacharias the son of Barachias.

translations.lxx: And make me witnesses of faithful men, Urias, and Zacharias the son of Barachias.
translations.kjv: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
translations.ron: Adu-Mi martori credincioşi pe Urie preotul şi pe Zaharia, fiul lui Ieberechia".
translations.grk: Πάρεστι γάρ· καὶ μάρτυράς μοι ποίησον πιστοὺς ἀνθρώπους, τὸν Οὐρίαν καὶ Ζαχαρίαν υἱὸν Βαραχίου.

verses.geez: ወሖርኩ፡ በበ፡ ብእሲት፡ ነቢይት፡ ወፀንሰት፡ ወወለደት፡ ወልደ።
verses.translation: And I went in to the prophetess; and she conceived, and bore a son. And the Lord said to me, Call his name, Spoil quickly, plunder speedily.

translations.lxx: And I went in to the prophetess; and she conceived, and bore a son. And the Lord said to me, Call his name, Spoil quickly, plunder speedily.
translations.kjv: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
translations.ron: Atunci m-am apropiat de proorociţă şi a luat în pântece şi a născut un fiu. Şi a zis Domnul către mine: "Pune-i numele Maher-Şalal-Haş-Baz".
translations.grk: Καὶ προσῆλθον πρὸς τὴν προφῆτιν, καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβε, καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱόν· καὶ εἶπε Κύριός μοι, κάλεσον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, Ταχέως σκύλευσον, ὀξέως προνόμευσον·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ያእምር፡ ሕፃን፡ ሰምየ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወእሙ፣፡ ይነሥእ፡ ኃይለ፡ ደማስቆ፡ ወምህርካ፡ ሰማርያ፡ በቅድመ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ።
verses.translation: For before the child shall know how to call his father or his mother, one shall take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria before the king of the Assyrians.

translations.lxx: For before the child shall know how to call his father or his mother, one shall take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria before the king of the Assyrians.
translations.kjv: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
translations.ron: Căci înainte ca băiatul să zică: "tată şi mamă!", toată bogăţia Damascului şi prada Samariei vor fi duse înaintea regelui Asiriei".
translations.grk: Διότι πρινὴ γνῶναι τὸ παιδίον καλεῖν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα, λήψεται δύναμιν Δαμασκοῦ, καὶ τὰ σκῦλα Σαμαρείας ἔναντι βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων.

verses.geez: ወይቤለኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዳግመ፡ ዓዲሂ።
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to me yet again, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to me yet again, saying,
translations.kjv: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
translations.ron: Şi mi-a mai grăit Domnul astfel:
translations.grk: Καὶ προσέθετο Κύριος λαλῆσαί μοι ἔτι·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢፈቀዱ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ማየ፡ ሰሊሆም፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ጽሚተ፡ ወይፈቅዱ፡ ይርከብዎ፡ ለረአሶን፡ ወልደ፡ ሮሜልዩ፡ ያንግሡ፡ ለክሙ።
verses.translation: Because this people chooses not the water of Siloam that goes softly, but wills to have Rassin, and the son of Romelias to be king over you;

translations.lxx: Because this people chooses not the water of Siloam that goes softly, but wills to have Rassin, and the son of Romelias to be king over you;
translations.kjv: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
translations.ron: "Fiindcă poporul acesta a nesocotit apele Siloamului, care curg lin, şi a tremurat înaintea lui Reţin, feciorul Remaliei,
translations.grk: Διὰ τὸ μὴ βούλεσθαι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ Σιλωὰμ τὸ πορευόμενον ἡσυχῆ, ἀλλὰ βούλεσθαι ἔχειν τὸν Ῥασσὶν καὶ τὸν υἱὸν Ῥομελίου βασιλέα ἐφʼ ὑμῶν,

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ናሁ፡ ያመጽእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ማየ፡ ፈለግ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወኃይለ፣፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ በኵሉ፡ ክብሩ።
verses.translation: therefore, behold, the Lord brings up upon you the water of the river, strong and abundant, even the king of the Assyrians, and his glory: and he shall come up over every valley of yours, and shall walk over every wall of yours:

translations.lxx: therefore, behold, the Lord brings up upon you the water of the river, strong and abundant, even the king of the Assyrians, and his glory: and he shall come up over every valley of yours, and shall walk over every wall of yours:
translations.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
translations.ron: Iată acum că Domnul va aduce peste ei apele cele mari şi furioase ale Eufratului: pe regele Asiriei şi toată strălucirea lui. Ele vor trece peste toate zăgazurile şi vor da afară peste malurile lui.
translations.grk: διατοῦτο ἰδοὺ Κύριος ἀνάγει ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ ποταμοῦ, τὸ ἰσχυρὸν καὶ τὸ πολὺ, τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἀσσυρίων, καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἀναβήσεται ἐπὶ πᾶσαν φάραγγα ὑμῶν, καὶ περιπατήσει ἐπὶ πᾶν τεῖχος ὑμῶν,

verses.geez: ወያጠፍእ፡ እምይሁዳ፡ ብእሴ፡ ተባዕተ፡ ወያኀልቆሙ፡ ለኃያላን።
verses.translation: and he shall take away from Juda every man who shall be able to lift up his head, and every one able to accomplish anything; and his camp shall fill the breadth of thy land, O God with us.

translations.lxx: and he shall take away from Juda every man who shall be able to lift up his head, and every one able to accomplish anything; and his camp shall fill the breadth of thy land, O God with us.
translations.kjv: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
translations.ron: Şi se va revărsa în Iuda, îl va îneca şi îl va umple de apă, va ajunge până la gât şi cu revărsările lui întinse va acoperi toată ţara.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀφελεῖ ἀπὸ τῆς Ιουδαίας ἄνθρωπον, ὃς δυνήσεται κεφαλὴν ἆραι, ἢ δυνατὸν συντελέσασθαί τι· καὶ ἔσται ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτοῦ ὥστε πληρῶσαι τὸ πλάτος τῆς χώρας σου, μεθʼ ἡμῶν ὁ Θεός.

verses.geez: አእምሩ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወተመውኡ፤ ስምዑ፡ እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ወተመውኡ፡ ኃያላን፤ ወእመሂ፡ ካዕበ፡ ጸናዕክሙ፡ ካዕበ፡ ትትመውኡ።
verses.translation: Know, ye Gentiles, and be conquered; hearken ye, even to the extremity of the earth: be conquered, after ye have strengthened yourselves; for even if ye should again strengthen yourselves, ye shall again be conquered.

translations.lxx: Know, ye Gentiles, and be conquered; hearken ye, even to the extremity of the earth: be conquered, after ye have strengthened yourselves; for even if ye should again strengthen yourselves, ye shall again be conquered.
translations.kjv: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
translations.ron: Cu noi este Dumnezeu, înţelegeţi neamuri şi vă plecaţi. Auziţi până la marginile pământului, cei puternici plecaţi-vă. De vă veţi întări, iarăşi veţi fi biruiţi.
translations.grk: Γνῶτε ἔθνη καὶ ἡττᾶσθε, ἐπακούσατε ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς· ἰσχυκότες ἡττᾶσθε· ἐὰν γὰρ πάλιν ἰσχύσητε, πάλιν ἡττηθήσεσθε.

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ መከርክሙ፡ ምክረ፡ ይመይጥ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ምክረክሙ፤ ወነገርኒ፡ ዘተናገርክሙ፡ ኢይከውነክሙ፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ምስሌነ።
verses.translation: And whatsoever counsel ye shall take, the Lord shall bring it to nought; and whatsoever word ye shall speak, it shall not stand among you: for God is with us.

translations.lxx: And whatsoever counsel ye shall take, the Lord shall bring it to nought; and whatsoever word ye shall speak, it shall not stand among you: for God is with us.
translations.kjv: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
translations.ron: Şi orice sfat veţi sfătui, îl va risipi Domnul, şi cuvântul pe care îl veţi grăi nu va rămâne întru voi, căci cu noi este Dumnezeu!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἣν ἂν βουλεύσησθε βουλὴν, διασκεδάσει Κύριος· καὶ λόγον ὃν ἐὰν λαλήσητε, οὐ μὴ ἐμμείνῃ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὅτι μεθʼ ἡμῶν ὁ Θεός.

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ እንዘ፡ ይጌሥጸኒ፡ በእዴሁ፡ ጽንዕት፡ ወይዛለፈኒ፡ በቃለ፡ አፉሁ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፤ ኢትሖር፡ በፍኖተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord, With a strong hand they revolt from the course of the way of this people, saying,

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord, With a strong hand they revolt from the course of the way of this people, saying,
translations.kjv: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
translations.ron: Aşa îmi zicea mie Domnul, ţinând peste mine mâna Sa cea tare şi însuflându-mi să nu umblu pe căile acestui popor. Apoi mi-a zis:
translations.grk: Οὕτω λέγει Κύριος, Τῇ ἰσχυρᾷ χειρὶ ἀπειθοῦσι τῇ πορεὶᾳ τῆς ὁδοῦ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου, λέγοντες,

verses.geez: ኢትበሉ፡ ዕጹበ።
verses.translation: Let them not say, It is hard, for whatsoever this people says, is hard: but fear not ye their fear, neither be dismayed.

translations.lxx: Let them not say, It is hard, for whatsoever this people says, is hard: but fear not ye their fear, neither be dismayed.
translations.kjv: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
translations.ron: "Nu numiţi uneltire tot ceea ce poporul acesta socoteşte uneltire, şi nu vă temeţi, nici nu vă înfricoşaţi de ceea ce se tem ei.
translations.grk: μήποτε εἴπωσι, σκληρόν· πᾶν γὰρ ὃ ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ λαὸς οὕτος, σκληρόν ἐστι· τὸν δὲ φόβον αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ φοβηθῆτε οὐδὲ μὴ ταραχθῆτε.

verses.geez: ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ቀድስዎ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ይከውነከ፡ ግርማከ።
verses.translation: Sanctify ye the Lord himself; and he shall be thy fear.

translations.lxx: Sanctify ye the Lord himself; and he shall be thy fear.
translations.kjv: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
translations.ron: Numai pe Domnul Savaot socotiţi-L sfânt, de El să vă temeţi şi să vă înfricoşaţi.
translations.grk: Κύριον αὐτὸν ἁγιάσατε, καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται σου φόβος.

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ ተወከልከ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይቄድሰከ፡ ወኢያዐቅፈከ፡ ከመ፡ እብነ፡ ዕቅፍት፡ ወኢከመ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ዘያድኅፅ።
verses.translation: And if thou shalt trust in him, he shall be to thee for a sanctuary; and ye shall not come against him as against a stumbling-stone, neither as against the falling of a rock: but the houses of Jacob are in a snare, and the dwellers in Jerusalem in a pit.

translations.lxx: And if thou shalt trust in him, he shall be to thee for a sanctuary; and ye shall not come against him as against a stumbling-stone, neither as against the falling of a rock: but the houses of Jacob are in a snare, and the dwellers in Jerusalem in a pit.
translations.kjv: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
translations.ron: El va fi pentru voi piatră de încercare şi stâncă de poticnire pentru cele două case ale lui Israel, cursă şi laţ pentru cei ce locuiesc în Ierusalim.
translations.grk: κᾂν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ πεποιθὼς ᾖς, ἔσται σοι εἰς ἁγίασμα, καὶ οὐχ ὡς λίθου προσκόμματι συναντήσεσθε, οὐδὲ ὡς πέτρας πτώματι· οἱ δὲ οἶκοι Ἰακὼβ ἐν παγίδι, καὶ ἐν κοιλάσματι ἐγκαθήμενοι ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.geez: ወበበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይደክሙ፡ ብዙኃን፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ወይወድቁ፡ ወይትቀጠቀጡ፡ ወይቀርቡ፡ ወያሠግሩ፡ ሰብአ።
verses.translation: Therefore many among them shall be weak, and fall, and be crushed; and they shall draw nigh, and men shall be taken securely.

translations.lxx: Therefore many among them shall be weak, and fall, and be crushed; and they shall draw nigh, and men shall be taken securely.
translations.kjv: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
translations.ron: Şi mulţi se vor poticni, vor cădea şi se vor sfărâma, vor fi prinşi în cursă şi vor fi duşi în robie!"
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ἀδυνατήσουσιν ἐν αὐτοῖς πολλοὶ, καὶ πεσοῦνται καὶ συντριβήσονται, καὶ ἐγγιοῦσι, καὶ ἁλώσονται ἄνθρωποι ἐν ἀσφαλείᾳ.

verses.geez: ወያጸንዑ፡ ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ እሙንቱ፡ እለ፡ የኀትምዋ፡ ለኦሪት፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትመሀርዋ።
verses.translation: Then shall those who seal themselves that they may not learn the law be made manifest.

translations.lxx: Then shall those who seal themselves that they may not learn the law be made manifest.
translations.kjv: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
translations.ron: Voi strânge laolaltă această mărturie şi voi sigila această învăţătură pentru ucenicii mei.
translations.grk: Τότε φανεροὶ ἔσονται οἱ σφραγιζόμενοι τὸν νόμον τοῦ μὴ μαθεῖν.

verses.geez: ወይብል፤ እጸንሖ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘሜጠ፡ ገጾ፡ እምቤተ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወእትዌከል፡ ቦቱ።
verses.translation: And one shall say, I will wait for God, who has turned away his face from the house of Jacob, and I will trust in him.

translations.lxx: And one shall say, I will wait for God, who has turned away his face from the house of Jacob, and I will trust in him.
translations.kjv: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
translations.ron: Voi aştepta deci pe Domnul, Care îşi ascunde faţa Sa de la casa lui Iacov şi voi nădăjdui întru El.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐρεῖ, μενῶ τὸν Θεὸν τὸν ἀποστρέψαντα τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου Ἰακὼβ, καὶ πεποιθὼς ἔσομαι ἐπʼ αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ነየ፡ አነ፡ ወደቂቅየ፡ ዘወሀበኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Behold I and the children which God has given me: and they shall be for signs and wonders in the house of Israel from the Lord of hosts, who dwells in mount Sion.

translations.lxx: Behold I and the children which God has given me: and they shall be for signs and wonders in the house of Israel from the Lord of hosts, who dwells in mount Sion.
translations.kjv: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
translations.ron: Iată eu şi pruncii pe care mi i-a dat Dumnezeu spre semne şi minuni în Israel, din partea Domnului Savaot, Care locuieşte în Muntele Sionului.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἅ μοι ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεός· καὶ ἔσται σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ παρὰ Κυρίου σαβαὼθ, ὃς κατοικεῖ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σιών.

verses.geez: ወእመቦ፡ ዘይቤሉክሙ፤ ኅሥዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይትናገሩክሙ፡ እምታሕተ፡ ምድር፡ ወለእለ፡ በፃውዕ፡ እለ፡ ይትናገሩ፡ ከንቶ፡ ወይነቡ፡ ሐሰተ፡ እምልቦሙ፤ አኮኑ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ይስእሉ፡ ኀበ፡ ጣዖቶሙ፤ እለ፡ የኀሡ፡ በእንተ፡ ሕያዋን፡ እምኀበ፡ ምውታን።
verses.translation: And if they should say to you, Seek those who have in them a divining spirit, and them that speak out of the earth, them that speak vain words, who speak out of their belly: shall not a nation diligently seek to their God? why do they seek to the dead concerning the living?

translations.lxx: And if they should say to you, Seek those who have in them a divining spirit, and them that speak out of the earth, them that speak vain words, who speak out of their belly: shall not a nation diligently seek to their God? why do they seek to the dead concerning the living?
translations.kjv: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
translations.ron: Şi când vă vor zice: "Întrebaţi pe cei ce cheamă morţii şi ghicitorii care şoptesc şi bolborosesc", să le răspundeţi: "Nu se cuvine oare poporului să alerge la Dumnezeul său? Să întrebe oare pe morţi pentru soarta celor vii?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐὰν εἴπωσι πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ζητήσατε τοὺς ἐγγαστριμύθους, καὶ τοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς φωνοῦντας, τοὺς κενολογοῦντας, οἳ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας φωνοῦσιν· οὐκ ἔθνος πρὸς Θεὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκζητήσουσι; τί ἐκζητοῦσι περὶ τῶν ζώντων τοὺς νεκρούς;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ሕገ፡ ወሀበ፡ ለረድኤት፡ ከመ፡ ይበሉ፤ ኢኮነ፡ ከመዝ፡ ነገሩ፡ ወኢየሀቡ፡ ሐፍሠ፡ በእንቲአሁ።
verses.translation: For he has given the law for a help, that they should not speak according to this word, concerning which there are no gifts to give for it.

translations.lxx: For he has given the law for a help, that they should not speak according to this word, concerning which there are no gifts to give for it.
translations.kjv: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
translations.ron: Întrebaţi legea şi descoperirea! De nu vă vor vorbi asemenea cuvântului acesta, atunci nu-i lumină în ei.
translations.grk: Νόμον γὰρ εἰς βοήθειαν ἔδωκεν, ἵνα εἴπωσιν οὐχ ὡς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο, περὶ οὗ οὐκ ἔστι δῶρα δοῦναι περὶ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወበዝ፡ ይመጽእ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ረኃብ፡ ወእምከመ፡ ርኅብክሙ፡ ትቴክዙ፡ ወትነቡ፡ ሕሡመ፡ ላዕለ፡ መላእክት፡ ወላዕለ፡ መኳንንት፡ ወትኔጽሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰማይ።
verses.translation: And famine shall come sorely upon you, and it shall come to pass, that when ye shall be hungry, ye shall be grieved, and ye shall speak ill of the prince and your fathers' ordinances: and they shall look up to heaven above,

translations.lxx: And famine shall come sorely upon you, and it shall come to pass, that when ye shall be hungry, ye shall be grieved, and ye shall speak ill of the prince and your fathers' ordinances: and they shall look up to heaven above,
translations.kjv: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
translations.ron: Vor rătăci pe pământ flămânzi şi cumplit apăsaţi, şi în vremea foametei îşi vor arăta colţii şi vor huli pe regele lor şi pe Dumnezeul lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἥξει ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς σκληρὰ λιμὸς, καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν πεινάσητε, λυπηθήσεσθε. καὶ κακῶς ἐρεῖτε τὸν ἄρχοντα καὶ τὰ πάτρια· καὶ ἀναβλέψονται εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἄνω,

verses.geez: ወታሕተ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፤ ወትሬእዩ፡ ጽፉቀ፡ ጽልመተ፡ ወትትመነደቡ፡ ዓቢየ፡ ምንዳቤ፤ ተሐሙ፡ ወትጼነሱ፤ ይጸልመክሙ፡ ቅድሜክሙ፡ ወኢትሬእዩ፡ ወኢይትበላሕ፡ ዘተመንደበ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ይበጽሕ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ ለዝ።
verses.translation: and they shall look on the earth below, and behold severe distress, and darkness, affliction, and anguish, and darkness so that one cannot see; and he that is in anguish shall not be distressed only for a time.

translations.lxx: and they shall look on the earth below, and behold severe distress, and darkness, affliction, and anguish, and darkness so that one cannot see; and he that is in anguish shall not be distressed only for a time.
translations.kjv: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
translations.ron: Apoi îşi vor întoarce privirea spre pământ şi iată că acolo va fi strâmtorare, întuneric şi scârbă şi nevoie! Dar noaptea va fi alungată!
translations.grk: καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν κάτω ἐμβλέψονται· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀπορία στενὴ, καὶ σκότος, θλίψις, καὶ στενοχωρία, καὶ σκότος ὥστε μὴ βλέπειν· καὶ οὐκ ἀπορηθήσεται ὁ ἐν στενοχωρίᾳ ὢν ἕως καιροῦ.
